title: A/P Detail: Past Due is negative for a bill not yet due
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has a bill due in about 9 days.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open "Current".
  4. Find vendor Y's bill.
  5. Read its Past Due.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • a negative number of days (about -9). The exact day count is the subject of open ticket SV-11922; do not raise a new ticket for a one-day difference.

Why this matters: Accounts payable plans payments by days until due.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingDetailFetcher.php:151. V1 code, quoted: `'TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, vt.due_date, :asOfDate) AS pastDue'`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-135) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
